name: Lemon Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8x8 inch pan.
Mix 1 cup flour, 1/4 cup powdered sugar, and salt. Cut in cold butter until crumbly.
Press crust firmly into the bottom of prepared pan.
Bake crust 15-18 minutes until lightly golden.
Whisk eggs, granulated sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest, and 1/4 cup flour until smooth.
Bake 20-25 minutes until filling is set and no longer jiggly.
Cool completely then dust with powdered sugar before cutting.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free butter in the crust.
substitutions.gluten_free: Use a 1:1 gluten-free flour blend for both crust and filling.

notes: Pour filling over the hot crust — this helps it bond and prevents a soggy bottom.
